I'll compute the sum of the digits of 34! using code to verify the result.
<function_calls>
<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Calculate 34 factorial
factorial_34 = math.factorial(34)
print(f"34! = {factorial_34}")

# Convert to string and sum the digits
digit_sum = sum(int(digit) for digit in str(factorial_34))
print(f"Sum of digits: {digit_sum}")
EOF
</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>
